notes.hashRouting: jitsi-meet routes rooms by path (/RoomName). The production server answers any non-asset path with the app shell, so path routing survives a root-mounted proxy. It does not survive being mounted under a sub-path.
notes.startup: npm run build compiles the bundles and deploys the assets into build/; npm start runs server/index.js, which binds the port from PORT (no flags) and refuses to start if the build output is missing. Demo mode (node demo/start.js, npm run demo) is a separate development path and is not what the preview runs.
notes.externalDependencies: None to build, start or browse. Signalling is only contacted once a room is actually joined, at the backend named by MEETSPACE_BACKEND.
